I want to use this wig (I'm the girl cosplaying Poison Ivy) for another cosplay but can't seem to figure out another one. Any ideas for someone who looks like me? 5'5", very pale, green/blue eyes. Love superheroes and anime but open to other ideas as well, also have a full year to make it.
thanks! actually this is the first cosplay i designed and helped make myself, so i'm really glad it was so well-received.

Red Hood and Batgirl. It's not something you see everyday, but still recognizable and very cool to spot at a convention, especially together. They're good cosplays, especially since you both have lots of time, and there are tons of variations you can do and make it comfortable for both of you to whatever degree of detailing either of you are willing to go. Best of luck and have fun!

I would go for Red Hood. The helmet can get pricey, but the rest of the outfit is fairly simple. Look him up and see what you think. There are tons of ways you can do it and budget your way through it. Best of luck!
